results.title: Watch: Amit Shah to meet families of three victims amid Punjab drug row
results.content: Amit Shah’s visit to Punjab has brought the State’s drug crisis into the political spotlight, with the BJP and AAP trading accusations. Shah is scheduled to meet the families of three people who died in incidents linked to the drug menace. Meanwhile, Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has announced that the probe into anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota’s murder will be handed over to the CBI.

results.title: India-New Zealand FTA comes into force, new visa categories for Indians, duty-free access for export
results.content: India-New Zealand FTA Takes Effect: India’s free trade agreement with New Zealand came into force on October 20, 2026, eliminating tariffs on 100% of Indian exports and incorporating $20 billion in foreign direct investment into India. Additionally, 95% of New Zealand’s exports to India will enter tariff-free or at sharply reduced levies. The deal was originally signed in New Delhi on April 27 and ratified following New Zealand parliamentary legislation passed on September 16.

results.title: Watch: Trump says migrants, jihadists and communists are ‘destroying’ France
results.content: U.S. President Donald Trump criticises European leaders over immigration and NATO, saying the U.S. stood by Europe despite its flaws but received no support when it asked for help during the Iran conflict. He accuses migrants, jihadists and communists of destroying France and warns that the U.S. will not allow similar developments at home.
